content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to connect [product_name] with MATLAB? I am working on a project involving real-time color recognition using a camera. I need [product_name] to activate a motor and control a mechanical system—when a specific sensor is triggered, the program should start, and when another sensor activates, it should stop, turning off the motor. I would appreciate any information regarding this integration. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to connect [product_name] with MATLAB for a real-time color recognition project that automates a mechanical setup using sensor feedback. The main challenge is finding a way to directly integrate and control [product_name] from MATLAB, enabling seamless real-time automation. There is a notable lack of clear documentation or support for this integration, highlighting a need for accessible cross-platform connectivity solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward and direct communication between MATLAB and [product_name] to manage a physical system in real-time, triggered by sensor input and camera-driven color recognition.
